usages.explain: Expresses the meaning "besides that, there are many other similar things". In many cases, it implies that there are many objects and events mixed together in a chaotic manner.

examples.content: ビールやらなにやらを持ち寄ってパーティーを開いた。
examples.transcription: びーるやらなにやらをもちよってぱーてぃーをひらいた。
examples.mean: We brought beer and stuff and had a party.

examples.content: 解雇されるやらなにやらで、恋について考える暇もなかった。
examples.transcription: かいこされるやらなにやらで、こいについてかんがえるひまもなかった。
examples.mean: I didn't have time to think about love because I was getting fired or something.

usages.synopsis:
N + やらなにやら
A い／V-る + やらなにやら

title: やらなにやら => In addition to the facts / things, there are many other things like that …
